shortDescription: Resource module for Reserve Ip Subpool

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_host
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center hostname.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_port
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center port.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Id of reserve ip subpool to be deleted.

options.name: ipv4DhcpServers
options.description: IPv4 input for dhcp server ip example "1.1.1.1".

options.name: ipv4DnsServers
options.description: IPv4 input for dns server ip example "4.4.4.4".

options.name: ipv4GateWay
options.description: Gateway ip address details, example 175.175.0.1.

options.name: ipv4GlobalPool
options.description: IP v4 Global pool address with cidr, example 175.175.0.0/16.

options.name: ipv4Prefix
options.description: IPv4 prefix value is true, the ip4 prefix length input field is enabled , if it is false ipv4 total Host input is enable.

options.name: ipv4PrefixLength
options.description: The ipv4 prefix length is required when ipv4prefix value is true.

options.name: ipv4Subnet
options.description: IPv4 Subnet address, example 175.175.0.0. Either ipv4Subnet or ipv4TotalHost needs to be passed if creating IPv4 subpool.

options.name: ipv4TotalHost
options.description: IPv4 total host is required when ipv4prefix value is false.

options.name: ipv6AddressSpace
options.description: If the value is omitted or false only ipv4 input are required, otherwise both ipv6 and ipv4 are required.

options.name: ipv6DhcpServers
options.description: IPv6 format dhcp server as input example "2001 db8 1234".

options.name: ipv6DnsServers
options.description: IPv6 format dns server input example "2001 db8 1234".

options.name: ipv6GateWay
options.description: Gateway ip address details, example 2001 db8 85a3 0 100 1.

options.name: ipv6GlobalPool
options.description: IPv6 Global pool address with cidr this is required when Ipv6AddressSpace value is true, example 2001 db8 85a3 /64.

options.name: ipv6Prefix
options.description: Ipv6 prefix value is true, the ip6 prefix length input field is enabled , if it is false ipv6 total Host input is enable.

options.name: ipv6PrefixLength
options.description: IPv6 prefix length is required when the ipv6prefix value is true.

options.name: ipv6Subnet
options.description: IPv6 Subnet address, example 2001 db8 85a3 0 100. Either ipv6Subnet or ipv6TotalHost needs to be passed if creating IPv6 subpool.

options.name: ipv6TotalHost
options.description: IPv6 total host is required when ipv6prefix value is false.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the reserve ip sub pool.

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId path parameter. Site id to reserve the ip sub pool.

options.name: slaacSupport
options.description: Slaac Support.

options.name: type
options.description: Type of the reserve ip sub pool.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
